title: Total length of gate clauses
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $b$ be a Boolean value, and let $cs$ be a finite list of Boolean circuit trees on $n$ variables. The total number of literal occurrences in the clauses associated with $b$ and $cs$ is $3|cs|+1$.
hypotheses_covered: $cs$ is a finite list of Boolean circuit trees on $n$ variables
